purpose: Latest-main native whole-battle A/A and A/B full measurement

oldCohortDifferences.geometryAssetIdentity: Same Hagglefish stage LFS record 8b994f56e2c5f3d1ca1795bbc13cd748358ffbaa00d36a0fe7d5027d95180ffa; both latest builds bind all 17 source LFS payloads.
oldCohortDifferences.interpretation: Only matched latest-main ordinals are compared. Do not compare full-run timings directly to earlier-cohort smokes, profile, or 960x640 runs.

admission: native=true / eight actors / seven bots / eight ready source characters before every timed window
source SHA and private Git LFS oid/size binding before browser launch; every served body SHA/size checked
all numeric window results finite; gameplay and visible-pose digest finite checks retained
before/after affinity checks for all observed browser threads and constant GPU PID
all warmups, measured windows, failures, cgroup snapshots and HTTP receipts retained

timingPolicy.cgroupThrottling: Record every delta; do not silently remove throttled windows. Timing-noise acceptance separate from recorded-state parity.
timingPolicy.parentCoordination: Parent stated no heavy parallel work during full run.

observerCaveats: Fixed GPU0-1 / worker2-3 host affinity under four-core cgroup quota changes the experiment; not natural scheduler/device FPS.
Scene rendering disabled; paint atlas draws remain active. SwiftShader is software work.
Per-frame wall excludes subsequent observers; renderer ThreadTime includes digests, counters and CDP work.
Preparation and GL drain excluded from timing; no forced GC or CPU/allocation profiling.
Each window reconstructs a real match; only matching rematch ordinals are compared.
Exact recorded state does not prove all pixels, audio samples, every private field or external-device behavior.
Previous 30frame smoke had one A/A outlier with 8 throttled periods/359013us; preserved and not used to infer speed.

reexecution.reason: Environment reconnection interrupted the previous run; same conditions restarted from the beginning.
